_: steps: the keep stands on storeys of stone podium with the kit's stairs up its front (castle_builder.gd), a red carpet (carpet colour, carpet_w metres wide, carpet_lift off the steps) down them and across the bailey to gate_in metres inside the gate, a guard either side of the door at the top (castle_life.gd). gate_walkers: through Meshy's open gatehouse, count folk (the first a guard) walk in from the road (out metres past the gate) through the passage into the bailey (inside metres in), wait_s there, and out again, abreast apart, at pace. A seat's kit castle lived in (realm/scripts/castle_life.gd; North Star docs/art/target/01-town.jpg: banners on the towers, guards on the walls, the gate lit at dusk, a well in the bailey). only castles our builder raises. arms: the house's painted banners hung flat where the kit castle's plain cloths hung (down the keep, either side of the gate; size: times the castle spec's banner size, for the gate's and the curtain's; keep: the two on the keep's face either side of its door, and tower: the one down each front round tower over its painted cream cloth, each {x: metres off the middle (the keep's mirrored), top, z: its face, w, h} in the piece's own metres (ck_keep, ck_wall_tower as imported; 01-town); curtain_every: one along the front curtain facing the square every this many metres, clear of the gatehouse, curtain_size times size). banners: a house standard on each corner and gate tower (size in world units, lift: metres above the tower's top course, for its cone). guards: how many walk each curtain's walk (they turn at the towers, look out a moment, walk back; pace in metres a second; look_s: how long they stand at each end), in the castle lord's colours. torches: either side of the gate's arch (metres out from the arch's middle, how high), lit from works.json day.lit (dusk) to dawn: a warm light (energy, range in world units) and a small flame each. well: the bailey's well, in the castle's frame (world units from its middle, as the bailey's other pieces in towns.gd). Stone curtains (walls.gd, --walls=stone): the kit's curtain walls are left out of the castle and stone walls stand in their place, each taking the town's wall wear for the section it faces (bridge damage.js), so a siege breaches the castle too.

outcrop._: The castle's rock (castle_life.gd _outcrop; 01-town: the castle on its outcrop, shrubs and cypresses on the rock): on; rocks (assets.json castle_rock) every metres along the outer foot of every curtain, out metres from it, size times their 3 m, sunk sink metres; a shrub (castle_shrub) every bush_every metres and a slim cypress (castle_cypress: the nature set's cypress, 8 m by 2 m, narrowed across by cypress_squash; 1 as it was made) every cypress_every metres; front_clear metres either side of the gate towers left open.

meshy_gate._: Meshy's gatehouse in the front curtain (castle_builder.gd): z, metres its middle stands out from the wall's line (1.0 before round 4: 3.5 m proud with nothing beside it, it stood apart from the wall); half_w, half_d its half width and depth (meshy/gatehouse/import.json size_m 14.71 x 5.06); towers, the kit's cone towers either side, flanking it as 01-town's gate.

bailey_buildings._: The bailey's buildings against the curtain wall (castle_life.gd _bailey_buildings; Mac on Kingsmere from above: "the emptiness looks kinda weird"; 01-town, Stronghold's yard): kit houses of a tier (assets.json house_kit.tiers) built narrow, their backs to the wall and their fronts to the yard. on: the switch. wall_in: metres from the bailey's half-width (half-depth for the back) to the curtain's inner face; scale: the kit's metres (house_kit.scale's storey rule). Per row: tier, side (left, right as you face the keep from the gate; back), at (along that wall, a share of the bailey's half-depth, + toward the gate; for the back, of its half-width, + right), w and d (2 m cells: w along the wall), floors, seed. Placed to clear castle_folk.json's drill, archers, stores and smith and dressing.json bailey's props.

meshy._: The Meshy castle set (castle_builder.gd _meshy_tower, _meshy_curtain, the keep; docs/art/castle): keep scale (1: its imported 15.7 x 17.5 x 20 m) and z (metres toward the gate from the keep's place); tower round and square, the pieces at the corners and gate, and midway along a royal seat's side walls; width, metres across; cone, metres of roof over its stone storeys; wall piece, depth (metres through, walk and all), over (metres of merlons over the curtain's storeys).
